name: explore-furniture
title: Explore a piece of furniture
description: See every support layer of one piece of furniture (each shelf, the top, a cabinet's inside shelves): sweep from where the robot stands when it is already near, else from up to three stand-off poses in front of it, aiming the head at each layer not seen yet, then again with the torso lowered for the layers still hidden (a bottom shelf behind the front edge of the shelf above). A layer is seen when the space just above its board is in the head camera and no board of the piece is in the way. Succeeds only when every layer was seen; a closed cabinet door hides its inside layers.
use_when: Every shelf of one bookcase, shelf unit or cabinet must be seen: what is on each layer, or which layer is free.

not_to_be_confused_with.explore_room: explore_room glances at every piece of a room, one layer each.
not_to_be_confused_with.look: look aims at one target; explore_furniture at every layer of one piece.

furniture.description: The bookcase, shelf unit, table, desk or cabinet to cover.

postconditions.name: furniture_explored
postconditions.meaning: Every support layer of the furniture (each shelf, the top) was seen in the head camera.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: furniture_explored
checks.meaning: Every support layer of the furniture (each shelf, the top) was seen in the head camera.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

previous.when: every shelf of one piece of furniture must be seen

next.when: an object seen on a layer must be fetched
next.reason: the seen output names the objects on the layers

fallback.when: a closed cabinet door hides the inside layers
fallback.reason: an open door uncovers the inside shelves; explore again

fallback_for.when: the object may sit on a shelf the sweep only glanced at

alternative.when: only one layer must be seen

failure.on_failure: stop; return the error code and every measured pre- and postcondition; nothing is retried or repaired, the planner chooses what to do.
typical: a layer stays hidden from every stand-off pose, standing and crouched
a closed door hides a cabinet's inside layers
holding an object: the torso is not lowered, so low shelves may stay hidden
